name: SEO Content Desk (seodraft)
tagline: An editorial desk that plans, drafts and audits SEO content for your own blog.
description: A writing desk for people who publish their own blog. It suggests topics with realistic search demand, turns them into SERP-aware briefs, drafts each post from source material you supply, and flags thin or overlapping pages before they ship. Runs on the seodraft MCP server, with a free trial and a small monthly fee.
author: chorch_md
notes: Native Grok Bot share. Third-party bot; not from xAI.
